sentences.en: In the last analysis, methods don't educate children; people do.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，方法并不能教育孩子；人能做到。

sentences.en: People are more educated now than they used to be.
sentences.zh: 现在人们比以前受过更多的教育。

sentences.en: He was born in England, but was educated in America.
sentences.zh: 他出生在英国，但在美国接受的教育。
